naming.value: CES in project-cited REON PDF; CESS on current REON hardware page

ac_interface.source: REON_WHO_WE_ARE.pdf as quoted in project Addendum §AA1; original file unavailable in repository

rated_duration_h.source: 5 MWh / 2.5 MW nameplate arithmetic; usable AC discharge not established

chemistry.source: No CES-specific chemistry in the checked REON hardware page

cell_dc_topology.source: No CES-specific cell count, parallel columns, DC window or N_min published

switch_loss.source: No CES-specific switch-path resistance or loss published

model_boundary: ASSUMED: interpret the public nameplate energy as nominal cell-side input; modeled deliverable energy includes assumed cell-to-AC efficiency. Published rating boundary UNKNOWN.

p_max_kw: Comparison size follows the published CESS 2.5 MW rating, but is not an EBS/CES internal specification; modeled as an AC output cap
e_nom_kwh: REON lists up to 5 MWh but its measurement boundary is unknown; model interprets this as cell-side nominal energy before 96% AC efficiency
chemistry: Na-ion laboratory proxy; CES chemistry UNKNOWN; LFP is a research sensitivity
n_strings / n_series: 8 parallel strings × 240 switchable model units; no CES topology published
headroom / n_min: 10% bypass headroom gives N_min=216 model units; no CES DC window published; sensitivity 2%-20%
eta_discharge: 96% base; 90%-99% operational sensitivity; CES PCS curve and energy-rating boundary UNKNOWN
dc_window: Not enforced in main plant model; CES DC minimum/maximum and cell voltage curve require REON data
switch_loss: 1% base, 0.5%-5% operational sensitivity; CES switch R_on UNKNOWN
dispatch_days: Operators dispatch on several candidate days per month
initial_age_years: Mixed-age cohort ages; historical duty and measured SOH unavailable
tier3_weak_share / tier3_rest_soc: Independent per-cell resting SOC and recharge before peaks are unconfirmed
guard_threshold: 1.5% one-sided exponentially smoothed discrepancy versus annual pack test
k_hvac / sigma_t_cell: No public CES thermal data; ask REON
sigma_meas: Brief: per-cell SOH/capacity given; estimation error assumed
peak events: ISO-NE SMD 2019-2025: system monthly peaks + WCMA dry bulb
co2_kg_per_kwh: 31-92 kg CO2e/kWh cell manufacturing (J. Ind. Ecol. 2025 + others)
Na-ion cap_cov: Bahrke et al., EES Batteries 2026: capacity CoV 1.15% (94 cells)
Na-ion aging_sigma: Calibrated to the TUM within-test-point spread (3.1% vs 23.4% loss); sensitivity
Na-ion rho_r_aging: TUM: R_DC vs coulombic efficiency r = -0.675; used as a proxy
Na-ion cal_a: Fit to TUM Table 5 (630 d storage, 6 clean points); leave-one-out 0.011-0.016
Na-ion ea_kj: Fit to TUM 25 vs 45 C only; leave-one-out 24-37 kJ/mol; authors: two temperatures are not enough
Na-ion cyc_b: TUM TP8/TP9 (60-100% SOC windows, ~4300 EFC) minus fitted calendar loss; full 0-100% windows fade >10x faster
Na-ion beta_soc: Fit to TUM Table 5; 25 C value poorly identified (leave-one-out 1.7 to bound 3.0); 25 C 50/70% SOC cells excluded (plating per authors)
Na-ion low_soc_penalty: Set 0: TUM capacity loss is lowest at 10% SOC (anode LAM highest but not capacity-limiting)
Na-ion cold_slope: Leeds, Appl. Energy 2026: 51-62% capacity at -40 C (linearised)
Na-ion t_charge_min: Vendor Na-ion datasheet: charge 0-40 C (not REON)
Na-ion t_derate: Vendor datasheet discharge limit 60 C; derate onset assumed 45 C
Na-ion fault_hazard_yr: Base case 0; scenario only (TUM observed plating in lab cycling)

Sterling.src: MMWEC 'who we serve' page (year not stated)
